prompts.player: Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: transparent production head-and-shoulders portrait for a Chinese cultivation game. Input image 1 is the edit target and identity reference; retain that character, face, age, hair and clothing identity. Input image 2 is ONLY a material/color/lighting reference from the game environment, never copy its scenery or objects. Primary request: repaint the existing portrait as polished semi-realistic new Chinese fantasy game art, clearer sculpted planes and expressive eyes, visible restrained brushwork, believable silk and hair texture, cool jade ambient light with a warm lantern rim light. Single centered character, fully visible hair and shoulders inside the frame, small safe margin, readable when displayed small. Subject: The young male player portrait: preserve the face, long dark half-tied hair, simple wood hairpin, ivory and muted jade scholar robes; calm and resolute. Background: genuinely transparent alpha, no backdrop or opaque rectangle. Keep a clean softly antialiased silhouette, no colored fringe. No text, letters, signature, watermark, UI, frame, extra people or invented story props. Preserve transparency. Output square PNG at native available resolution, do not imply 4K.
